title: Heap
summary: The smallest value is always on top, like the most urgent patient in a hospital.

viz.asArray: the same heap as an array
viz.hello: This heap has room for {n} values and holds {count}. The smallest, {min}, is on top. Try insert, removeMin or peek.
viz.inserted: insert({value}): it went into the first free slot, index {index}, as a new leaf at the bottom.
viz.insertedRoot: insert({value}): the heap was empty, so {value} became the root.
viz.siftUpSwap: {value} is smaller than its parent {parent}, so they swap. {value} climbs to index {index}.
viz.siftUpStay: {value} stays at index {index}, because its parent {parent} is smaller.
viz.siftUpRoot: {value} reached the root. It is the new smallest value.
viz.removed: removeMin(): took {value} from the root. The last value, {moved}, jumps to the top and now has to sink down.
viz.removedLast: removeMin(): took {value}. The heap is empty now.
viz.siftDownSwap: {value} is bigger than its smaller child {child}, so they swap. {value} sinks to index {index}.
viz.siftDownStay: {value} stops at index {index}, because no child below it is smaller.
viz.siftDownLeaf: {value} stops at index {index}. There is nothing below it.
viz.peeked: peek(): the smallest value is {value}, at the root. Nothing moved.
viz.overflow: insert({value}): the heap is full, all {n} slots are taken. This is overflow.
viz.underflow: The heap is empty (count = 0), so there is nothing to take. This is underflow.
viz.arrayNote: The row under the tree is the same heap as an array. The parent of index i is at (i - 1) / 2, its children at 2i + 1 and 2i + 2.
viz.resetDone: Started again with an empty heap.
